physicalDetails.detail: On foot, walking out of Andorhal along the verge while everything else goes in. A man in his middle years, going grey above the ears, with ink at the edge of one cuff. A leather satchel hangs at his hip, flap buckled over the bulk of a ledger; the strap has worn a long pale stripe across the front of his coat, shoulder to hip. No distinguishing face is described. (Deliberately unlike the Ch3 carter: no crooked nose, no hat, no cob, no flat wagon.)

voiceMarkers.detail: Helpful, pleasant, ordinary: 'This noon. Yes, ma'am. Can I help you?' Wry about the town ('The factors say it's the factors, the corn guild says the guild, the town says the town, and all three will sit you on a bench in the hall till they light the lamps.'). Clear directions in order ('Keep to this road all the way in; at the bottom of the hill the carts bear off left for the yards, but you keep straight on, and it brings you to the market gate. There's a militia post just inside it on the left, with a bench outside the door.'). 'Ask there for Captain Havel... He knows the granary district better than anybody. Better than the factors do, and they'd sooner not hear it.' Locked parting line to Jaina: 'May the stars keep your road.'

goalsAtChapterEnd.active: Walk on out of Andorhal. (Unknown; seen from outside only.)
goalsAtChapterEnd.underlying: Unknown. Surface read only: a clerk giving a stranger directions. He steers the party to Captain Havel.

emotionalStateAtChapterEnd.state: Wary then easy: takes a half step back onto the grass when stopped by armed riders, hand over his satchel buckle; his shoulders come down when Jaina speaks courteously; ducks his head to all four.

decisionsThisChapter.detail: Answered Sylvanas's stop with courtesy; named Captain Havel as the man to walk them round the granary yards; gave the route to the market gate and the militia post; looked back over his shoulder toward the granaries as he answered; said the farewell to Jaina as she passed and walked on; was gone in the road traffic before Sylvanas looked back.

howOthersAddressHim.speaker: Sylvanas
howOthersAddressHim.pattern: 'You've come from Andorhal.'; 'Who runs the granaries?' (no title).

howOthersAddressHim.speaker: Jaina
howOthersAddressHim.pattern: 'sir' ('Thank you, sir. You've been very kind.').

bodyLanguagePatterns.detail: Stops when Sylvanas's horse crosses his path; looks up at her, then along the rest, taking in bows, tall horses, Cyndia's hand near her quiver and the staff in the crook of Jaina's arm; half step back; hand over the buckle of his satchel; head shake and a laugh; shoulders come down; looks back over his shoulder toward the granaries (nothing visible but the rise and the dust); ducks his head to all four; steps off the road to let them by; looks up at Jaina as she passes.

knowledge.detail: On the page he claims to have come from Andorhal 'this noon', knows the town's rival granary authorities, knows Captain Havel and the militia post at the market gate. On the page he also looks the four riders over (bows, tall horses, Cyndia's hand, the staff) and glances back toward the granaries; from Jaina's POV this reads as a man sizing up armed strangers. No character reads it as more. (The verified plan marks him as a planted figure for Ch7-8; that is plan intent, not canon.)

arc.currentPosition: One-scene character. Sylvanas judges the farewell 'wrong' (second time), Jaina read nothing off him. He was gone before Sylvanas looked back.
